title: Fix Playwright Core Bundle Errors in Play Site
description: Vite dependency optimizer tries to bundle playwright-core which requires chromium-bidi. Need to exclude playwright-related packages from Vite's dep optimization in the play site.
summary: Fixed Vite dependency optimization errors in compose play site. Added `@playwright/test`, `playwright`, and `playwright-core` to `optimizeDeps.exclude` in `vite.config.ts`. Root cause: `@semio-tech/compose-sketchpad/index.tsx` imports from `@playwright/test` (type imports + dynamic test imports), causing Vite's esbuild pre-bundler to scan `playwright-core` which has unresolvable `chromium-bidi` imports. Verified dev server starts cleanly with no errors.
